cohort: The study included 74 children (mean age 9 years) diagnosed with ADHD and 80 healthy control children matched for age and gender.
finding: Multivariate analysis showed that passive smoking during pregnancy, acute fetal distress, and familial psychiatric history were independently associated with ADHD.
mod_finding: Univariate analysis found caesarean delivery to be more prevalent in children with ADHD, though it was not an independent factor in the multivariate model.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was found to be more prevalent in children with ADHD in univariate analysis.
gest_age: Prematurity was found to be more prevalent in children with ADHD in univariate analysis.
